title: Merge Meeting Slots
statement: You are given a list of meeting slots, where each slot is a pair `[start, end]`. Merge every group of overlapping slots and return the remaining non-overlapping slots, sorted by start time. Slots that only touch at an endpoint count as overlapping.
hints: What happens to the problem if the slots are sorted first?
Only the most recently merged slot can overlap the next one.
Check what your code does before the loop when there are no slots at all.
pitfalls: Not sorting first, so overlapping slots that aren't next to each other never merge.
Setting the merged end to the new slot's end instead of the max of both, which breaks when one slot contains another.
Treating slots that only touch, like [1,4] and [4,5], as separate.
Reading slots[0] before checking for an empty list.
interviewerNotes: Ask why sorting by start makes a single pass enough.
Probe a slot fully inside another, like [1,10] and [2,3].
Ask whether touching slots merge, and see if they clarified it before coding.
Ask what the sort costs compared to the merge pass, and whether sorting the input in place is acceptable.
